'''Giant coatis''', like their [[Coati|smaller cousins]], may steal items from the fortress if given an opportunity and will take any item they can get their paws on. Best [[ambusher|hunted]] or [[cage trap|baited]] and killed before they get away with something useful. Though large enough, they are not a viable base creature for your [[meat industry]] because of their solitary nature. The chances of getting a [[breeding]] pair are extremely low and you are better off slaughtering them.
